RULE-1.formula: If selling price, cost, and their difference are known, then profit per candle is that difference

RULE-2.formula: If profit per candle, number of candles, and their product are known, then total loss from sales is that product
RULE-2.verify_reason: It treats total loss as the product of per-item profit and quantity; mislabels the final quantity.

RULE-3.gloss: ∀p ∀n ∀r ∀c ∀np ((TotalRevenue(p, n, r) ∧ TotalCost(c) ∧ Subtract(r, c, np)) → NetProfit(np))
RULE-3.formula: If revenue, cost, and their difference are known, then net profit is that difference

INF-1.formula: from RULE-1 using FACT-2, FACT-1, FACT-3 by Modus Ponens

INF-2.formula: from RULE-2 using INF-1, CandlesSold(twenty), Multiply(negative_eight_dollars, twenty, negative_one_hundred_sixty_dollars) by Modus Ponens
